facts.fact: Four 领她进恐惧模拟室，当着她的面把手伸进火里——那火只是投影，她过一拍才反应过来。
facts.anchor: Four approaches the flames, firelight playing across his stern brow and his aquiline nose. He puts his hand in the fire

facts.fact: 模拟启动：桌上只有一把枪，枪口朝着别处；父亲站在她对面，苍白出汗、双手被绳捆住。
facts.anchor: Then a table appears in front of me, and on it is a single gun, pointed away from me. My father stands across from me.

facts.fact: 顶在她太阳穴上的不是飞镖枪，而是装实弹的枪——这一场里会真的死。
facts.anchor: It’s not a needle gun. This one is bigger, more solid. No luminous stripe.

facts.fact: Weaver 把父亲挡在自己和她之间，枪口改指父亲后脑，逼她自己开枪。
facts.anchor: She puts him between her and me, and points the gun at the back of his head, instead.

facts.fact: 她开枪打偏，击中父亲肩膀，血涌出来；Weaver 随即朝父亲后脑开枪。
facts.anchor: I fire, but my aim is off. I hit my father in the shoulder, and blood gushes from the wound

facts.fact: 她明白 Four 起疑的缘由：她敢赌那把枪不会响，因为她知道这是模拟——而真话是她是 Divergent，所以不能说。
facts.anchor: I realize, suddenly, what the problem is. My real explanation for telling that woman to go ahead and shoot me is that I knew the simulation wasn’t real. Because I’m Divergent.

facts.fact: 章末她提出交换条件：她不劝他脱离无派系，他要在她说「我有自己的理由」时相信她。
facts.anchor: “I’ll promise not to try to get you to become factionless,” I say. “If you promise to believe me when I tell you I have my own reasons for doing things.”

facts.fact: Four 承认自己「几乎」信她——差一点，但还差那一点。
